# Issue 3141 hosted pool diagnostic — do not merge this harness branch

One ubuntu-latest VM, sequential A1/B/A2 fresh processes, both revisions built and fixtures validated before timing. Reservoir stays 1.6.7. Record main at dispatch/run, exact harness SHA, SDK/runtime, hardware, runner image and all loaded assemblies.

Workload: one warm PendingRequestPool Rent/Return/ApproximateCount operation, capacity256, threadLocalFastPath false, same-thread return. Common compiled BenchmarkDotNet0.15.8 fixture, Release net10.0, InProcessEmit, affinity logical CPU2, workstation GC, DOTNET_TieredCompilation=1, DOTNET_TieredPGO=1, DOTNET_ReadyToRun=1. No broker. Reuse retained reset-timing fixture with binary paths changed only. This is a new product comparison, not a repeat of the Reservoir dependency experiment.

Per fresh process: at least20 seconds exact workload setup warmup with completed operations and JIT/thread-pool/CPU/GC/heap/RSS observations; then30 one-second BDN workload warmups,25 one-second actual iterations; DontRemove preserves all samples. Runtime logger observes every workload boundary. Verify actual elapsed BDN workload warmup. The runtime logger adds no timer/background thread. Smoke runs validate identity/count on both compiled products before measurement. All failed runs and partial logs are retained.

Predeclared narrow diagnostic thresholds: 0 B/op in MemoryDiagnoser, at most2% A1/A2 mean drift, and B no more than5% slower than either control. Startup transitions or wider control drift make timing INCONCLUSIVE; no identical repeat. Keep absolute means, confidence bounds, sample counts and maxima, candidate deltas against each control and control drift. This is an allocation/timing diagnostic, not overall acceptance. BDN iteration statistics do not measure per-message p50/p99/max. Loaded client throughput, per-message CPU/latency and sustained stability are missing; the full performance gate cannot PASS from this run. No protected tradeoff is authorized.

This correction changes only the diagnostic counter balance when request cleanup throws. Correctness tests exercise the real request completion, library protocol writer, exception identity/discard, successful reuse, full capacity, null rejection and concurrent failures. Exception-path allocations are cold-path and excluded from the warm reuse claim. No public client delivery behavior changes. Local timing was not started because another worker occupied the host; local smoke results are validation only.
